build_categorical_head: build a CategoricalHead with a given feature dimension and number of classes for single-label classification
build_multilabel_head: build a MultiLabelHead with a given feature dimension and number of classes for multi-label classification
build_head_factory: build a prediction head using build_head given a feature dimension and task key set
predict_categorical: predict class logits or softmax probabilities from input representations using CategoricalHead
compute_loss_and_metrics: compute cross-entropy loss and per-example error metrics from inputs and targets using loss_and_metrics
